nodes.label: vehicle-images storage bucket
nodes.rationale: Public read-only bucket for faster loading and simpler caching; unpublished photos only reachable via random UUID URL.

nodes.label: Siroče datoteke nakon brisanja
nodes.rationale: If storage delete fails after record delete, orphan file remains unseen; error is logged.

nodes.label: Sigurnost fotografija (magic bytes, WebP, UUID)
nodes.rationale: Server checks file signature not name/MIME; rejects SVG/HTML/executables; re-encodes to WebP removing EXIF/GPS; random UUID paths.

nodes.label: npm run admin:create
nodes.rationale: Registration via site is disabled, so the first admin is created by script that prints a one-time temporary password.

nodes.label: JSON-LD (AutoDealer, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, Car, Offer)
nodes.rationale: Offer only for available/incoming vehicles with price, to avoid inaccurate data.

nodes.label: Ovlast administratora (getClaims + is_admin)
nodes.rationale: Admin status determined only by a row in admins table, not user-editable metadata; checked server-side on every page, action, API route and again via RLS.

nodes.label: CSP 'unsafe-inline' kompromis
nodes.rationale: Nonces would make all public pages dynamic and lose caching; risk is low because there is no user HTML and JSON-LD is escaped.

nodes.label: Keširanje (ISR 5 min, revalidacija)
nodes.rationale: Public pages static with 5-minute ISR; any admin change revalidates all public pages so reserved/sold never shows as available; admin pages no-store.

nodes.label: Prikaz rezerviranih i prodanih (postavke + RLS)
nodes.rationale: Display choice in settings applies immediately to RLS; hidden means not reachable via API either; sold vehicles never auto-deleted.

nodes.label: Isključena samoregistracija
nodes.rationale: Only admins create accounts; even a self-registered user has no access because they are not in the admins table.

nodes.label: Vitest + PGlite testovi
nodes.rationale: PGlite runs real PostgreSQL in-process so all migrations and RLS can be tested; it imitates but is not identical to Supabase, so manual verification is still needed.

nodes.norm_label: auto centar dea web stranica i administracija

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules (breaking changes notice)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing code. Block is auto re-added by next dev, so committing it keeps the tree clean.

nodes.label: Navigacija bez hamburger izbornika (donja traka)
nodes.rationale: Desktop horizontal menu; mobile fixed bottom bar with 5 destinations respecting iOS safe-area and equal bottom padding so nothing is covered.

nodes.label: submit_inquiry (DB function)
nodes.rationale: Inquiries never inserted directly; only service_role may call this function.

nodes.label: Sigurnosne kopije (supabase db dump)
nodes.rationale: Free Supabase plan has no automatic backups; weekly dump recommended; storage photos not included.

nodes.label: vehicle_internal table
nodes.rationale: VIN and notes isolated in admin-only table; trigger copies VIN to vehicles.public_vin only when admin enables it.

nodes.label: Poslovna pravila u bazi (okidači)
nodes.rationale: Immutable auto slug, no publish without photo, sold/archived cannot be featured, auto reservation/sale dates, inquiry content immutable.

nodes.label: Cijene kao bigint minor units (price_bam_minor)
nodes.rationale: Never float; per-vehicle currency KM or EUR; EUR converted at fixed currency board rate 1.95583 so price filtering/sorting works.

nodes.label: Ograničenje učestalosti upita (HMAC IP)
nodes.rationale: 3 inquiries per 10 min and 15 per day per address, enforced atomically in DB by HMAC hash of IP; raw IP never stored.

nodes.label: sharp obrada slika (WebP re-encode)
nodes.rationale: Photos resized client-side to 2560px then server re-encodes to WebP up to 2400px, keeping uploads under Vercel's 4.5MB request limit and stripping EXIF/GPS.

nodes.label: Resend email obavijesti
nodes.rationale: Built in but disabled until keys set; inquiries are still stored and the app never claims email was sent.

nodes.label: SEO strategija
nodes.rationale: Filter combos get noindex,follow with canonical to base list to avoid thin pages; llms.txt omitted for lack of proven benefit; server-rendered HTML works without JS.

nodes.label: ALLOW_INDEXING gate
nodes.rationale: Until true, robots.txt disallows and all pages are noindex so temporary URLs do not end up in Google.

nodes.label: Politika indeksiranja po statusu vozila
nodes.rationale: Available/incoming/reserved indexed; sold stays at same URL for link value but noindex; archived/unpublished return 404.
